item.title: Caitlin Clark Makes NBC Pregame Debut, Praises Luka Doncic
item.description: Caitlin Clark made her NBC pregame debut on Sunday, giving props to Luka Doncic and playing HORSE with NBA icon Jamal Crawford. The post Caitlin Clark Makes NBC Pregame Debut, Praises Luka Doncic appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Olympic Runner Nikki Hiltz Claims 1st Wanamaker Mile Win in Personal-Best Performance
item.description: Olympic runner Nikki Hiltz captured their first Wanamaker Mile victory with a personal-best 4:19.64 at New York's Millrose Games. The post Olympic Runner Nikki Hiltz Claims 1st Wanamaker Mile Win in Personal-Best Performance appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Emma Raducanu Returns to Winning Form at Transylvania Open After Coaching Split
item.description: Emma Raducanu returned to form with a commanding straight-set victory over Greet Minnen at this week's Transylvania Open. The post Emma Raducanu Returns to Winning Form at Transylvania Open After Coaching Split appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Alexandra Eala Reaches Career-High WTA Ranking Before Abu Dhabi Challenge
item.description: World No. 45 Alexandra Eala became the highest-ranked Filipina player in WTA history this week, scoring wildcard entry to the Abu Dhabi Open. The post Alexandra Eala Reaches Career-High WTA Ranking Before Abu Dhabi Challenge appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: UCLA Tops Iowa as Bruins Near Perfect 2025/26 Big Ten Basketball Record
item.description: No. 2 UCLA is on track to take the 2025/26 Big Ten regular-season title, adding a win over No. 8 Iowa to their perfect conference record. The post UCLA Tops Iowa as Bruins Near Perfect 2025/26 Big Ten Basketball Record appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: WNBA Sets In-Person Meeting with WNBPA Amid Stalled CBA Talks
item.description: Trying to cut through the back-and-forth, the WNBA and WNBPA will meet face-to-face for additional CBA negotiations in New York on Monday. The post WNBA Sets In-Person Meeting with WNBPA Amid Stalled CBA Talks appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Elena Rybakina Upsets No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka to Win 2026 Australian Open
item.description: New world No. 3 tennis star Elena Rybakina snagged a second Grand Slam trophy on Saturday after defeating No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka in the 2026 Australian Open final. The post Elena Rybakina Upsets No. 1 Aryna Sabalenka to Win 2026 Australian Open appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Nelly Korda Wins 1st LPGA Title Since 2024 at 2026 Tournament of Champions
item.description: US golfer Nelly Korda is back on top, winning the 2026 Tournament of Champions to claim her first LPGA trophy since the 2024 Tour. The post Nelly Korda Wins 1st LPGA Title Since 2024 at 2026 Tournament of Champions appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Arsenal Beats Corinthians to Claim Inaugural FIFA Women’s Champions Cup
item.description: Arsenal won the FIFA Women's Champions Cup on Sunday, defeating Brazil's SC Corinthians in extra time to take the inaugural 2026 title. The post Arsenal Beats Corinthians to Claim Inaugural FIFA Women’s Champions Cup appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Unrivaled Sets All-Time Pro Women’s Basketball Attendance Record in Philadelphia
item.description: Unrivaled set a new women's basketball attendance record on Friday, as the 3×3 league took over Philadelphia's Xfinity Mobile Arena. The post Unrivaled Sets All-Time Pro Women’s Basketball Attendance Record in Philadelphia appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
